name: Workflow-GYM
abstract: Workflow-GYM evaluates computer-use agents on long-horizon professional workflows in specialized software. This page uses Avg Pass (%) from the arXiv paper's updated Table 2.
contributions: The benchmark contains 338 realistic professional tasks spanning six domains and 56 virtual-machine software environments.
Every task requires at least 30 atomic actions, with the hardest workflows extending to 110 steps.
Evaluation checks final application state and produced artifacts, exposing stage omission, error propagation, objective drift, and insufficient software knowledge.
method: Domain experts design real workflows under four constraints: realism, domain specificity, long-horizon complexity, and verifiability.
Agents receive a natural-language objective without intermediate hints and must operate specialized desktop software to finish the workflow end to end.
The suite covers Data Analysis; Engineering & Design; Finance & Management; Geography & Environment; Multimedia & Creative; and Scientific Computing.
Each model runs every one of the 338 tasks three times, producing 1,014 trials; Avg Pass is the overall successful-trial percentage.

metrics.name: Avg Pass
metrics.note: Overall successful-trial percentage averaged across 338 tasks and three runs per task, as reported in arXiv Table 2.

leaderboard_note: The primary leaderboard uses the overall Avg Pass percentage from the paper's updated Table 2. Each of 338 tasks is attempted three times.
